title: Benefit Overpayment Accounts — Delay Months for Late-Established Overpayments
content:
An overpayment among Benefit Overpayment Accounts that the Department established long after the weeks it covers earns delay months on a new repayment plan, added to the plan months. The delay is measured in whole months from the last overpaid week to the determination date, both read from the overpayment record (the last overpaid week by its week ending date).

| Delay from the last overpaid week to the determination date | Months added to the plan months |
|---|---|
| 18 whole months or more (the long-delay months) | 6, the long-delay extension |
| 12 whole months or more but fewer than 18 (the short-delay months) | 3, the short-delay extension |
| Fewer than 12 whole months | None |

## Interpretive note

The measure runs from the end of the overpaid period, not from its start, to the date the determination was issued and mailed. A long overpaid period that ended shortly before the determination earns nothing.

## Hypothetical cases

| Last overpaid week ending | Determination date | Whole months | Months added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7 March 2024 | 10 September 2025 | 18 | 6 |
| 7 March 2024 | 5 September 2025 | 17 | 3 |
| 7 March 2024 | 7 March 2025 | 12 | 3 |
| 7 March 2024 | 6 March 2025 | 11 | None |
